summary: Master fleet management and vehicle utilization with practical tools, KPI dashboards, and maintenance controls. Enroll to improve performance.
lede: Fleet management training helps professionals responsible for vehicles, transport costs, or fleet reporting plan vehicle use and keep service reliable. It covers measuring utilization, availability, downtime, and fuel performance; scheduling preventive maintenance; and using telematics data and KPI dashboards to guide routing, cost control, and fleet risk decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage vehicles, control transport costs, or report on fleet performance. It fits the operational reality of people who must keep vehicles available, safe, and cost-effective while coordinating drivers, workshops, vendors, and leadership expectations. Fleet Coordinators responsible for daily vehicle allocation and utilization tracking. Transport Supervisors managing dispatch, driver assignment, and vehicle availability. Maintenance Planners scheduling inspections, service intervals, and workshop jobs. Logistics Managers balancing route efficiency, delivery timing, and fleet cost. Operations Managers overseeing service continuity and fleet performance reporting. Vehicle Asset Controllers monitoring usage, downtime, and lifecycle records. Fuel and Workshop Administrators reconciling consumption, repairs, and job cards. Compliance Officers reviewing inspection logs and incident documentation. Procurement Officers comparing fleet service vendors and maintenance contracts. Finance Analysts tracking vehicle cost centers and whole-life costing.
prerequisites: You will need a laptop, spreadsheet software such as Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, and familiarity with basic fleet records. If available, bring sample vehicle logs, fuel reports, maintenance schedules, telematics exports, or any internal fleet dashboard you currently use.
